method_note: Manual hand-check of a 35-row random sample (seed=7) drawn from the 920 scoreable trend claims in results/inspection/phase4_gate_raw_a0.5_s42.json (Phase 4's rolling-history conditions), per scripts/sample_trend_claims.py. Each row's heuristic verdict (was the model's cited trend direction correct against the actual sequence, via endpoint comparison with 5% relative tolerance) was independently judged by reading the full explanation text and the raw sequence, without deferring to the heuristic's own 'heuristic_correct' field. verdict values: 'agree' (the heuristic's correct/wrong call is confirmed by hand), 'ambiguous' (a genuine boundary case, defensible either way, not confidently scored), 'disagree' (the heuristic's verdict is itself wrong by hand-check -- none found in this sample).
